releaseNotes:
🚀 All Apps Notifications & Android 13+ Restricted Setting Fix (v1.0.7) by Dhiraj:
• 🌐 All Apps Notifications Capture: Removed Android OS conversation-only filter and added full package visibility (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES). Notifications from ALL apps (Banking, OTP, Shopping, Social, News, Food delivery) are now 100% saved!
• 🔓 Android 13/14/15 Restricted Setting Helper: 2-step interactive guide to unlock greyed-out Notification Access on sideloaded APKs effortlessly (App Info -> 3 dots ⋮ -> Allow restricted settings)
• 📱 Works Without Notification Access: WhatsApp Status Saver, Direct Chat, and PDF Export work 100% even if notification access is not enabled
• ⚡ Capture All Apps Preset: Toggling 'Monitor all installed apps' or 'Select All' reliably captures every app without dropping
